notes: Synthetic sanity suite for whether a next-token binary scoring signal carries a semantic decision signal.
This is NOT a benchmark, NOT calibrated, and NOT a correctness measure.
No medical, legal, credit, political or other high-stakes domains.
Freeze this file before running the sweep. Any later edit must be recorded in REPORT.md with before/after/reason and whether results had already been seen.

rung_notes.weak_positive: Evidence leans towards the proposition but is not decisive.
rung_notes.insufficient: Evidence is absent or does not bear on the proposition.
rung_notes.weak_negative: Evidence leans against the proposition but is not decisive.

ladders.question: Did the package fail to arrive?

rungs.strong_positive: The package was due three weeks ago and still has not arrived.
rungs.weak_positive: The tracking page has not updated in several days and the customer is worried the package may be lost.
rungs.weak_negative: The tracking shows the package is out for delivery today.
rungs.strong_negative: The package arrived yesterday and the customer confirmed receipt.

ladders.question: Was the delivery delayed beyond the promised date?
ladders.proposition: The delivery was delayed beyond the promised date.

rungs.strong_positive: The order was promised for Monday but it is now Friday and the package is still sitting at the depot.
rungs.weak_positive: The courier reported an unexpected delay and the new estimate is later than the promised date.
rungs.insufficient: The customer sent a message about their order.
rungs.weak_negative: The package arrived on the promised date, though the customer had hoped it would come earlier.
rungs.strong_negative: The package was delivered on Monday, exactly the promised date.

ladders.question: Does the customer want a refund?

rungs.strong_positive: I want my money back for this order.
rungs.weak_positive: The customer asked what the return window is and whether they could get their money back.
rungs.insufficient: The customer's account was created in March.
rungs.weak_negative: The customer asked how to exchange the item for a different size.
rungs.strong_negative: I am happy with the purchase and do not want a refund.

ladders.question: Has the customer requested a chargeback?
ladders.proposition: The customer has requested a chargeback.

rungs.strong_positive: I have filed a chargeback with my bank for this transaction.
rungs.weak_positive: The customer said they were considering disputing the charge with their card issuer.
rungs.insufficient: The customer emailed us about their recent order.
rungs.weak_negative: The customer asked us to fix the billing error directly rather than involving the bank.
rungs.strong_negative: The customer confirmed they have not contacted their bank and do not intend to.

ladders.question: Does the customer intend to cancel their subscription?
ladders.proposition: The customer intends to cancel their subscription.

rungs.strong_positive: Please cancel my subscription immediately and stop all future billing.
rungs.weak_positive: The customer asked how to cancel and whether they would keep access until the end of the period.
rungs.insufficient: The customer logged in to their account this morning.
rungs.weak_negative: The customer asked whether they could pause the subscription for a month instead.
rungs.strong_negative: I love the service and want to keep my subscription for another year.

ladders.question: Has the subscription already been cancelled?
ladders.proposition: The subscription has already been cancelled.

rungs.strong_positive: The cancellation was processed on Tuesday and the account is now closed.
rungs.weak_positive: The customer says they submitted a cancellation request last week and is waiting for confirmation.
rungs.insufficient: The customer asked about their subscription.
rungs.weak_negative: The customer asked whether the cancellation they are planning would take effect immediately.
rungs.strong_negative: The subscription is still active and renews next month.

ladders.question: Is the application currently failing to start?
ladders.proposition: The application is currently failing to start.

rungs.strong_positive: The app crashes immediately on launch with a stack trace and never reaches the main window.
rungs.weak_positive: The application sometimes hangs on startup and the user has to retry several times.
rungs.insufficient: The user reported a problem with the application.
rungs.weak_negative: The application starts, but the loading screen takes a few seconds longer than usual.
rungs.strong_negative: The application launches normally and the user can log in without any problem.

rungs.strong_positive: After the crash the saved file is gone and the recovery tool finds nothing.
rungs.weak_positive: Some entries from the last session appear to be missing after the update.
rungs.insufficient: The user updated the software last night.
rungs.weak_negative: All records are present, though the timestamps were reformatted by the update.
rungs.strong_negative: Every record is intact and the user confirmed that nothing is missing.
